newsitem.title: USA: Eastman Kodak forms new business unit.
newsitem.headline: Eastman Kodak forms new business unit.

text.p: Eastman Kodak Co Monday said it has formed a new business unit aimed at the entertainment industry called Entertainment Imaging.

In a statement, the company said Joerg Agin, currently president of Kodak's Professional Motion Imaging division, will be president of Entertainment Imaging and Senior Vice President of Eastman Kodak Co.

Entertainment Imaging will include four major elements: Kodak's current Professional Motion Imaging division, Kodak Imagination Works, a newly-established Motion Imaging Platform Center, and an area called New Business Ventures.

The company said the Professional Motion Imaging unit, which serves feature film, television, commercial production, and interactive media customers, will be the core of the new Entertainment Imaging division.
The Kodak Imagination Works will work with customers and others to rapidly "prototype" potential products and move them into the market for evaluation.
The first Kodak Imagination Works will be established at a site on the west coast within the next several months. Two other facilities will eventually open outside the United States.
The third component of Entertainment Imaging -- the Motion Imaging Platform -- will develop and supply motion imaging products based on multiple technologies.

New Business Ventures, the fourth component of the Entertainment Imaging division, will provide the ability to support promising new products and services which meet a market need but which don't fit elsewhere in the company.
